title: helm(private): stabilize values schema, templating, init jobs and rollback hooks for private installer
author: Priya Nayar
description: Context: The private (VPC/on-prem) Helm chart has accumulated multiple ad-hoc templating cases around nodeSelectors, tolerations, KMS integration, and init job ordering. These gaps caused two upgrade incidents where init hooks blocked rollout and a rollback left CRs in an inconsistent state. Motivation: unify values schema, make templating idempotent, and harden upgrade/rollback hooks so Private installer upgrades are safe across Helm v3.x and k8s clusters with strict webhook validation. Changes in this PR: - Introduce values.schema.json v3 and migrate existing values to a stricter, validated schema. - Add top-level flags: enableInitJobs (default: true), initJobPolicy (always|onUpgrade|never) to control init behavior during upgrades. - Templating improvements for nodeSelector/tolerations/KMS keys: prefer explicit map merges, avoid null vs omitted keys, and support both string and map forms for legacy values. - Rework init job templates (templates/initjobs/*): ensure pre-upgrade hooks are idempotent, write lock ConfigMap for cross-replica coordination, and add exponential backoff for retryable ops. - Rework rollback hook (templates/hooks/rollback.yaml): make it tolerant of partial state, add safe noop when resource already deleted, and move critical cleanup to post-install job guarded by annotation. - Add helm tests and a new e2e matrix in CI for upgrade->rollback->reinstall paths (k8s 1.24/1.25, Helm 3.9/3.11). - Docs: update private/README.md with migration notes and recommended upgrade commands. Migration notes and compatibility: - Clusters with previous schema that used string nodeselector/podAffinity are supported via backward-compatible parsing; the chart will emit deprecation warnings in helm template output. - For clusters that had custom initJob hooks relying on ordering, set initJobPolicy=always during the first upgrade to migrate state; afterwards it's safe to change to onUpgrade. Testing performed: - Local kind clusters (1.24, 1.25) ran through install, upgrade, rollback, and reinstall cycles. - CI: helm-lint, chart-testing, unit templating asserts, and staged e2e matrix passed (one flaky e2e rerun). - Manual smoke test on customer-like VPC setup with KMS enabled and nodeSelector/scheduling constraints. Checklist: - [x] values.schema.json v3 added and validated - [x] Templating fixes merged - [x] Init job idempotency and lock ConfigMap added - [x] Rollback hooks made tolerant and safe - [x] Helm tests and CI matrix updated - [x] Docs updated Related: ENG-2219 (values schema refactor), SUP-1123 (customer incident for rollback failure).
commit_summary: 7 commits: feat(values-schema): add v3 values schema and validation; feat(templating): normalize nodeSelector/tolerations/KMS handling; fix(init): idempotent init jobs with lock configmap; perf(helm): reduce chart template complexity; test(helm): add upgrade/rollback e2e matrix; docs: update private README and migration notes; chore: bump chart version to 2.14.0
review_comments: Evan Brooks: Can we avoid writing the lock ConfigMap in clusters with restricted RBAC? Suggest using leader-election with configmap only when rbac.create=true.
Priya Nayar (author): Added rbac.create guard and documented the requirement. When rbac.create=false the chart falls back to using pod annotation coordination.
Marta Kovacs: Schema looks good but please add explicit deprecation warning for string->map nodeselector conversions in NOTES.txt.
Priya Nayar (author): Added NOTES.txt deprecation warning and a migration command snippet for cluster admins.
Liam O'Connor: CI e2e matrix is great; saw one flaky test on upgrade path - reran and passed. Approving after green CI.
Evan Brooks: Verified rollback hook handles partially deleted CRs; approved.
merge_outcome: merged via squash (squash and merge). 7 commits squashed into a single commit and merged into main on 2026-03-01.
release_notes:
- Stabilize private Helm chart values schema (v3) with stricter validation and migration warnings.
- Add flags to control init job behavior during upgrades and improve init job idempotency.
- Make rollback hooks tolerant of partial state and add safer cleanup path.
- Add CI upgrade/rollback e2e matrix and helm tests.
- Documentation: migration notes and recommended upgrade commands.
testing: Unit templating asserts, helm-lint, chart-testing passed. CI e2e upgrade->rollback->reinstall matrix exercised on k8s 1.24/1.25 and helm 3.9/3.11; one flaky e2e was rerun. Manual verification on customer-like VPC with KMS enabled.
changelog_entry: charts/redwood-private: bump to 2.14.0; introduce values.schema.json v3; add initJobPolicy and enableInitJobs flags; templates fixes for idempotency and rollback safety.
notes_for_operators: If you rely on custom init hooks ordering: set --set initJobPolicy=always for the first upgrade to run migrations; afterwards switch to onUpgrade. For clusters with strict RBAC and rbac.create=false, the chart will use pod annotation coordination instead of ConfigMap locks. See charts/redwood-private/README.md for full instructions.
